name: @arganta/brand
description: The Brand OS contract — one BrandDoc per brand across 7 layers, with the two-lane rule enforced by storage itself: agent-lane (identity/KB/templates) lives in git, founder-lane (voice/spine/text) lives in Supabase, and the registry merges them. Every consumer — postEngine, Arganta Core, Buffer, Video Builder, media AIs — reads a brand instead of hard-coding one.
